scratchBoxes.instruction: Scratch if 62 (the Middle East) has not been opened.

states.revealedCondition: Box scratched because 62 (the Middle East) was still sealed.
states.revealedText:
Our scouts report that the Hollow Men have raided the Middle East. We quickly mobilized... but too late.

Open Package 2 and follow the instructions inside. (This does not complete any objectives.)

Destroy the "Renewal" Unrationed Event card inside.

mechanics.whenRead: STOP. Draw and read during step 2 of the setup of the first game in August.
triggers: 62 (the Middle East) has not been opened: scratch the box.
destroys: The "Renewal" Unrationed Event inside Package 2, if the box is scratched.
rules: If 62 is already open, scratch nothing.
If 62 is sealed, open Package 2 and follow the instructions inside.
Opening Package 2 this way does not complete any objectives.
Destroy the Unrationed Event named Renewal that is inside the package.
Destroy this card after resolving it.
mechanics.notes: "Open Package 2" and "Destroy the \"Renewal\" Unrationed Event card inside." are bold. 62 is in a red box. Side A is the same Stop face in state 2. The card does not itself say to open 62.
